purpose: Test whether the fixed candidate-similarity lifecycle rule naturally creates prediction-owned cross-video support on the qualified two-video RCM policy cache.
selection_rule: Use the first two frozen policy-order videos and the first two metadata clock frames of each; no score, label, coverage, or result selection.
interpretation: A zero-support result is a bounded mechanism diagnostic: it does not authorize threshold search, formal predicted training, or a scientific failure claim about the full method.
